headline: Start where one fact already crosses two tools.
lede: A small, consequential handoff proves more than a large import.

items.title: Choose one domain
items.body: Pick project state, a decision register, or another bounded area where a wrong value changes the work.

items.title: Connect two agents
items.body: Use the tools that currently force you to repeat or reconcile the same context by hand.

items.title: Correct and reread
items.body: Change one value, then verify that both tools see the current version and its history.
